question: Which fourth and second elements from the red class are specified for Pārvatī?
premises: The fourth element is taken from the red class.
The second element is also taken from the red class.
The instruction is addressed to Pārvatī.
inference: Both the fourth and the second elements of the red class are to be employed.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the fourth and second elements within the red class are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O Pārvatī, take the fourth and also the second element from the red class.
